segments.label: Launch & ascent — Cape Canaveral SFS LC-36
segments.note: Blue Origin New Glenn from Cape Canaveral SFS LC-36 (28.471°, -80.542°); ~9 min analytic ascent to a 185 km parking orbit (schematic arc, real pad and launch time).

segments.label: Parking orbit coast
segments.note: Circular 185 km parking orbit, inclination 32.1° (plane through the pad at launch and the Moon at arrival — the launch-window geometry). Coast 105 min to the trans-lunar injection burn.

segments.label: Trans-lunar coast (5.1 days)
segments.note: Two-body Lambert arc from the TLI point to the modeled LOI point (Moon's position from the ephemeris at LOI). Departure Δv 3138 m/s, arrival v∞ 0.81 km/s. Mid-course corrections not modeled.

segments.label: Lunar orbit (100 km)
segments.note: Circular orbit after LOI; the landing site has not been published, so no descent is drawn.
